metaDescription: Configure and launch AI agents across WhatsApp, phone, email and web chat in minutes.
title: Configure and launch agents in minutes
lede: Set up your AI agents once and expose them on all the channels your customers use. In minutes, not weeks.

channels.label: Channels
channels.title: One agent, every touchpoint
channels.body: Deploy agents across the channels your customers already use, from a single dashboard.

items.title: WhatsApp
items.body: Engage customers on the world's most popular messaging platform with rich media support.

items.title: Phone
items.body: AI-powered voice agents that handle inbound and outbound calls naturally.

items.title: Email
items.body: Automated email responses with context-aware threading and follow-ups.

items.title: Web chat
items.body: Embeddable chat widget for your website with customizable branding.

intro.label: Instruction modes
intro.title: Three ways to power your agents
intro.body: From simple prompts to advanced context engineering and visual multi-agent orchestration. Choose the right level of control for every use case.

sections.label: Prompts
sections.title: Start simple with a managed prompt library
sections.body: Write and iterate on prompts with built-in version control. Every change is tracked so you can review, revert, and keep a full audit trail as your agents evolve.

bullets.d: Organize and manage prompts across all your agents from a central library.
Every edit is tracked with a full audit trail. Review history and revert anytime.
Test new prompt versions in draft mode before releasing to production.

sections.label: Playbooks
sections.title: Control agents with precision
sections.body: Model composable guidelines that govern agent behavior with precision. Playbooks are inheritable, version-controlled, and support draft versions for safe testing before release.

bullets.d: Build modular rules that can be mixed, matched, and inherited across agents.
Version-controlled releases with draft and preview stages for safe iteration.
Define nuanced agent behavior that goes beyond what prompts alone can express.

sections.label: Flows
sections.title: Build multi-agent teams visually
sections.body: Design multi-agent teams in a visual builder to power complex agent behavior. The same flows can also run as standalone automations, triggered via API or on a schedule.

bullets.d: Model teams of specialized agents that collaborate to handle complex tasks.
Run flows as independent workflows via API triggers or scheduled jobs.
Expose flows as tools that your agents can call during conversations.

sections.label: Knowledge
sections.title: Every answer backed by your data
sections.body: Upload files, sync Google Drive and Notion, or crawl your website. NForce processes, chunks, and indexes everything so your agents retrieve exactly the right information.

bullets.d: Upload files, sync Google Drive and Notion, or crawl your website, all from one dashboard.
Vector similarity combined with keyword matching and AI reranking for precise retrieval.
Automatic sync keeps knowledge fresh as your source documents change.

sections.label: Funnels
sections.title: From first touch to outcome, fully automated
sections.body: Build structured outreach pipelines that run themselves. Define your stages, assign an AI agent, connect your CRM, and let NForce handle the rest. Leads advance through stages as work progresses, so nothing falls through the cracks.

bullets.d: Pull leads from HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or Notion, and write status updates, timestamps, and outcomes back automatically.
Set rules for when conversations go quiet. NForce follows up on your schedule, respects business hours, and stops when limits are hit.
Track conversion rates, time per stage, final outcomes, and follow-up effectiveness across every funnel.
Start from templates for chat outreach, phone outreach, or task workflows, then customize stages to fit your process.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.title: Connect the tools your team already uses
integrations.body: Agents plug into your existing stack out of the box. CRMs, calendars, knowledge bases and more, with no custom development needed.

metaDescription: Monitor, intervene, and manage your AI agents in real time, across every channel.
title: Stay in control of every conversation
lede: Monitor, intervene, and manage your AI agents in real time, across every channel, from a single inbox.

sections.label: Conversations
sections.title: A unified inbox for every agent interaction
sections.body: See every conversation across every channel in one place. Monitor what your agents are saying in real time, review full transcripts, and never lose track of a customer interaction.

bullets.d: All conversations from every channel (WhatsApp, phone, email, web chat) in one view.
Watch agent conversations as they happen with live message streaming.
Review complete conversation history with timestamps and metadata.
Agents converse in any language. Translate messages inline to follow along without switching tools.

items.text: Can you confirm the integration supports custom fields?
It does. Custom fields sync both ways with your CRM.

sections.label: Smart filters and tags
sections.title: Zero in on the conversations that matter
sections.body: AI-powered smart tags automatically categorize conversations by topic, sentiment, and intent. Combine them with powerful filters to find exactly what you're looking for in seconds.

bullets.d: AI automatically labels conversations by topic, sentiment, urgency, and custom categories.
Combine tags, channels, agents, date ranges, and status to find any conversation instantly.
Create and share custom filter presets for common workflows.

sections.label: Human in the loop
sections.title: Jump in when it matters most
sections.body: You're always in control. Jump into any conversation with a single click, or let agents flag situations that need human judgment. Full context is kept, so nothing gets lost in the handoff.

bullets.d: Switch from AI to human control mid-conversation, with no awkward transitions.
Agents raise alerts when they hit edge cases, detect frustration, or face uncertain situations.
Send escalations to the right person based on topic, language, or priority.
Set escalation rules based on sentiment, keywords, conversation length, or custom conditions.

card.title: Escalation · Data migration assistance
card.banner: Astra flagged this conversation: export request outside policy.

items.text: Is there a way to export our data in CSV format?
Let me bring in a teammate who can set that up for you.
Hi, I'm Jane. I can send you a CSV export today.

metaDescription: Track conversations, measure KPIs, and tie agent activity directly to revenue and cost savings.
title: Prove the impact of every agent
lede: Track conversations, measure KPIs, and tie agent activity directly to revenue and cost savings, all from one dashboard.

sections.label: Conversation metrics
sections.title: See the full picture at a glance
sections.body: Track every conversation and call across all channels. See volume trends, inbound vs. outbound splits, response rates, and more, updated in real time.

bullets.d: Monitor total conversations and calls across all channels over any time period.
Break down activity by direction to understand demand patterns.
Track how quickly and consistently agents engage with customers.

sections.label: KPI tracking
sections.title: Measure what matters
sections.body: Define custom KPIs by flagging smart tags as key performance indicators. Track them over time and see exactly how your agents are moving the needle on the metrics you care about.

bullets.d: Flag any smart tag as a KPI to turn conversation signals into measurable outcomes.
Define KPIs that match your business: appointments booked, issues resolved, leads qualified.
Track KPI performance over time to spot improvements and regressions.

sections.label: Financial impact
sections.title: Quantify your AI's ROI
sections.body: See the revenue generated and costs saved by your agents, broken down by KPI event. No more guessing whether AI is delivering. The numbers speak for themselves.

bullets.d: See the revenue associated with each KPI event your agents trigger.
Quantify how much agents save by automating conversations that would otherwise need people.
Present clear, stakeholder-ready reports that prove the value of your AI investment.

sections.label: Agent performance
sections.title: Spot your top performers
sections.body: See how each agent stacks up: conversations handled, KPIs hit, and financial impact, in one table. Identify top performers and surface agents that need attention.

bullets.d: Conversations, KPIs, and financial impact for every agent in one view.
Rank and compare agents to see what's working and replicate it.
Spot underperforming agents early and make data-driven configuration changes.

metaDescription: Test, iterate, and improve your AI agents continuously with automated testing.
title: Test, iterate, and improve continuously
lede: Flag what's wrong, build test cases, ship safe fixes, and prove they work, all without touching production.

sections.label: Flag and report
sections.title: Turn every bad conversation into a test case
sections.body: Review real conversations, flag the ones that went wrong, and describe the issue. Each flag automatically generates a test case, so every problem you catch becomes a permanent check against future regressions.

bullets.d: Flag any conversation directly from the inbox with a description of what went wrong.
Each flag produces a ready-to-run test case based on the real conversation.
Tag issues by type (wrong answer, missed intent, tone, tool failure) to spot patterns.

sections.label: Test suites
sections.title: Comprehensive testing for every scenario
sections.body: Build and manage test suites that cover everything from conversational flow and tone to tool calls and API interactions. Use real request and response pairs, or mock data to test edge cases with confidence.

bullets.d: Test full conversational flows from first message to resolution.
Verify agents call the right tools with the right parameters at the right time.
Use actual API responses for realism, or mock data to test edge cases and failure modes.
Group test cases by agent, feature, or scenario for structured regression testing.

sections.label: Draft and revise
sections.title: Iterate safely without breaking production
sections.body: Publish draft versions of prompts and playbooks to experiment freely. Test changes by hand or trigger automated test runs, then promote to production only when you're confident.

bullets.d: Create draft prompts and playbooks that run in isolation without affecting live agents.
Chat with draft agents directly to verify behavior before committing changes.
Trigger your test suites against draft versions to validate at scale.
Promote drafts to production once tests pass, with full version history to roll back.

sections.label: Run and validate
sections.title: Prove every fix before it ships
sections.body: Run full test suites that simulate and replay conversations end to end. Catch regressions before they reach customers and know that every change makes your agents better, not worse.

bullets.d: Re-run real conversations against updated agents to verify better outcomes.
Automatically compare results across versions to catch unintended side effects.
Clear test results with detailed diffs showing exactly what changed.
Run suites on every change to build a habit of testing and measurable progress.
